text:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty page fired: P1 reserved-pool latency spike for tenant=tailwind (alert RWD-TP-3821). 99th latency > 2s, error rate up 0.6%. Automatic routing fallback attempted and partially failed.

Maya (oncall): ack - I'm on it. paging into #eng-oncall.

Kevin SRE: on call for infra, joining. seeing the PD page too.

Maya (oncall): quick context: Tailwind is on a Dedicated reserved pool in us-west-2. Metrics show sustained high scheduler wait + iowait on nodes hosting that pool. KV cache eviction spike around the same time.

Jonah (platform): noted. I see a slew of tail retries in the request router: `route.fallback_count` increased, endpoint `generate-v2` returning 503s intermittently.

Maya (oncall): running quick checks, tailing logs now:
```
$ rwdctl reserved show tailwind --format json
{
  "pool": "tailwind",
  "utilization": "92%",
  "queued_requests": 180,
  "avg_latency_99": "2.3s"
}
```

Maya (oncall): also pulled pod logs for inference containers, here's a snippet:
```
[2026-03-14T14:03:02Z] WARN kvcache: eviction happened, entries=1200, reason=memory-pressure
[2026-03-14T14:03:04Z] ERROR runtime: blocking i/o: open /dev/nvme1n1: input/output error
[2026-03-14T14:03:06Z] ERROR handler: downstream request timeout
```

Kevin SRE: nvme errors are bad. possible disk flapping or kernel I/O. I'm SSHing into node ip-10-4-22-11 now.

Jonah (platform): flag: autoscaler hasn't scaled reserved pool because it's at reserved cap. policy is "no-burst" for this tenant. we can temporarily enable burst capacity to relieve queue.

Maya (oncall): customer-facing impact?

Tara Support: customer Tailwind reported timeouts in their UI ~14:03-14:10. Severity: high, some requests retried. no billing anomalies yet. I've drafted a message for their SREs, will coordinate once we have mitigation.

Lina (PM): Lina here — please keep me posted. This is on the weekly release customer list. Need ETA for mitigation, and whether we'll need to open a dedicated incident bridge.

Kevin SRE: kernel logs show repeated `blk_update_request I/O error` on nvme1n1. Looks like a degraded disk on 2 nodes. I'm marking them unschedulable and initiating graceful drain.

Maya (oncall): plan: 1) enable temporary burst quota for tailwind to shift some requests to hot spare pool, 2) evict/refresh KV cache to reduce mem pressure, 3) drain and reprovision affected nodes, 4) monitor error rate and rollback if regressions.

Jonah (platform): i'm pushing a short-lived routing policy to allow tailwind -> burst-pool for up to 10% of traffic:
```
# apply routing patch
rwdctl routing set --tenant tailwind --allow-burst true --burst-cap 10% --reason "io errors on reserved nodes"
```

Maya (oncall): doing the KV flush step now: `rwdctl cache flush --tenant tailwind --prefix kv:`

Incident Bot: PagerDuty note: page acknowledged by Maya (oncall) at 2026-03-14T14:04:20Z.

Tara Support: sent initial notice to Tailwind SREs: "We are seeing elevated latency and are applying short-term mitigations. Will update in 15 mins."

Kevin SRE: nodes cordoned and draining. starting replacement (reprovision) for ip-10-4-22-11 and ip-10-4-22-14. Provisioning new NVMe-backed instances.

Maya (oncall): post-burst: 99th latency dropped from 2.3s -> 600ms; queued requests down from 180 -> 40 in 4m. Error rate trending down.

Lina (PM): thanks team. please capture root cause steps for postmortem. P0: customer-visible degradation, P1 scope internal.

Jonah (platform): follow-up: autoscaler policy will be updated after the incident to allow emergency burst when disk-level errors are detected. filing infra ticket RWD-OPS-547.

Kevin SRE: replacement nodes healthy, NVMe OK on new hosts. rebalancing pods back onto reserved pool, monitoring i/o.

Maya (oncall): closing loop: will keep bridge open for 20 more minutes. Next update in 10. If stable, we'll resolve page and create incident doc.

Incident Bot: PagerDuty escalation suppressed (ack by Maya).

Tara Support: I'll coordinate the follow-up comms and include the customer impact window (14:03-14:20) plus our mitigation steps.

Maya (oncall): handoff to Kevin in 30 mins for post-incident: Kevin will own node reprovision and postmortem. I'm putting this thread into the incident tracker.

Kevin SRE: acked. taking post-incident ownership. will add mitigation notes and timeline to the ticket.

Maya (oncall): thanks all — marking as monitored. :white_check_mark:
